## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: A new feature

- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates
- [ ] `style`: Formatting or cosmetic changes

## Quality Checklist

- [ ] My PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/): `type(scope): subject` (e.g., `feat(dio): add custom header filter`).
- [ ] I ran `melos run check` locally and it passed with zero errors/warnings.
- [ ] I added/updated unit or widget tests for my changes.
- [ ] All new and existing tests pass (`melos run test`).
- [ ] Any public API changes are well-documented with dartdoc comments.
